answer: Admission follows a 16-epoch endorsement ladder. After commitment, each identity receives three random established reviewers; the kth account in one funding trellis needs 3k distinct reviewers, so 100 aliases require 15,150 endorsements. A crystal Merkle root binds reviewer draws and work receipts. Validators reject any hollow reviewer or reused receipt, slash a 45-POA bond, and reset every linked identity's ladder.
